verdict.rationale: The firm's PE/VC practice page states it serves private equity, venture capital, and sovereign funds across the deal lifecycle, and the Prarambh incubator connects startups to investors, but no page cites representative venture-financing transactions (seed, Series A/B, late-stage) or deal volume specific to founder-side priced equity rounds — cited deals (Rajasthan Royals, Hygenco) are growth/PE-scale, not staged venture rounds. Missing for 10: representative seed/Series-stage deal examples, stated venture deal volume, and founder-side transaction case studies.
